scope: One fixed text-only diagnostic; no images, bank data, notes or dataset splits
primary: Exact valid-format normal-stop correctness per cell; facts also nine individual Boolean fields. No response_format/grammar or adaptive prompts.
independence: Binding uses independently computed GROUND-TRUTH facts, never model numeric-facts answers. Direct-order anchors match earlier prompts; only the two orders change independently.
stop: Exactly18 calls unless technical failure/deadline; preserve partial aggregates, no retries, images or TRAIN. Technical failure and truncation cannot be called semantic incapacity.
monitor_scope: One compound all18-correct assertion; model call counts are separately aggregated
explicit_request_settings: Single user typed-text part; temperature0, fixed seed, max_tokens48, cache_prompt false, n1, streamfalse. No logit_bias, assistant prefill or stop override. Server defaults are not independently identified effective sampling settings.
